state_definitions.YES: The entire literal criterion at the stated limited scope is established by cited evidence; not task/global acceptance.
state_definitions.PARTIAL: A named part is supported; one or more clauses/consumers/proofs remain open. No numeric fraction is assigned.
state_definitions.NO: A cited observed counterexample contradicts this axis at the specified pin. Not a statement about every tree.
state_definitions.UNKNOWN: Insufficient current observation; does not mean unimplemented or zero progress.
state_definitions.NOT_ACCEPTED: No final same-C acceptance is established; implementation and scoped proof are separate.

acceptance_rule: All final requirements and three independent reviews belong to one C; D archives admitted evidence without claiming CI ran on D.
limits: Inspection is selective and published proof is scope-bound; all missing conclusions remain explicit UNKNOWN.
